prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally polished desktop website design comp, 1536x1024 landscape: a real web layout, edge to edge, no device frame, no browser chrome.

The attached reference images are screenshots of the SAME website's already-built pages (the homepage and the Walkthrough page). Carry over exactly: the header (script wordmark "Birdcar" at left; nav "How I work", "Selected work", "Writing" and a canary-yellow pill "Book a free Walkthrough →"), the pale daylight ground #edf3f0, near-black ink #0b141a, the heavy tight grotesk (Mona Sans) for all text, white cards with soft offset shadows, white pill tags, canary yellow #f7c848 only on actions and on small glowing packet cubes that travel dotted routes, teal #5fb8bf only for a resolved or "working" state, and the premium matte isometric miniature render style (soft studio daylight, fine architectural-model detail, pale wood, matte stone, teal-cyan floor tiles, tiny realistic figures, a small canary). Do NOT copy any reference's content: no homepage headline, no desk from the Walkthrough, no logo strip.

This page is "Selected work": a single work story about Craft & Communicate, a marketing agency. The only facts: the agency's client reporting involved finding performance numbers by hand; Nick (Birdcar) built a client-facing reporting platform with client management and live-updating data; the platform is now an offering the agency can sell to its customers. Any screen shown inside a miniature is an illustration: abstract chart lines and bars only, no numbers, no percentages, no metrics, no logos, no readable text on screens. The visitor's job: believe Nick builds real, useful systems, then book a Walkthrough.

STRUCTURE, in reading order (one report's journey: the page follows a single report down the page as you scroll):
1. Header, about 80px, as the reference.
2. First viewport, two columns. LEFT (x 80 to 700): headline about 76px, two lines: "Craft & Communicate". Below, a lead at about 22px: "A reporting platform that's part of the agency's service, not just the work behind it." Then a small white pill tag reading "Selected work" is NOT allowed; instead a muted line at about 17px: "Illustrated. Not a product screenshot or measured results."
RIGHT (x 760 to 1460, from y 100 running off the bottom): the start of a vertical route: at the top, a premium matte isometric miniature vignette of an agency workstation where a small figure sorts a tall scatter of paper reports and sticky notes by hand, a white pill tag beside it: "Finding the numbers by hand". From it, a dotted route runs down the page carrying one glowing canary-yellow packet cube, leading toward a second vignette just visible at the bottom edge: a compact isometric module of a clean reporting console with abstract teal chart lines, tagged "A client-facing reporting platform".
3. Beneath the left column (y 640 to 1000): the first story block on the daylight ground, a heading about 40px "Getting the numbers was part of the work." and a paragraph at about 18px: "Craft & Communicate's reporting involved finding performance numbers by hand. I built a client-facing platform to bring that work together, with client management and data that updates live."

ART DIRECTION: one dominant move, the route with its two vignettes; the left column is calm type. Premium, adult, precise. Not cute. No purple, no gradient orbs, no robots, no AI imagery, no stock photos, no numbers or results, no testimonials, no client logos. Preserve all quoted words exactly. Treat it as a finished, shippable website.
